startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to scrape, and to follow links from when a follow selector is set.

urlListUrl.title: URL list file
urlListUrl.description: URL of a text file with one URL per line. Use it for bulk jobs with millions of pages.

extract.title: Fields to extract
extract.description: Field name to CSS selector. A value can also be an object: {"selector": "a.next", "attr": "href", "all": true}. Without fields, the page title is stored.

followSelector.title: Follow links matching
followSelector.description: CSS selector of links to enqueue, for example `a[href]`. Leave empty to scrape only the listed URLs.

followGlobs.title: Follow only URLs matching globs
followGlobs.description: Glob patterns such as https://example.com/products/**. Without globs, only links on the same hostname are followed.

maxDepth.title: Maximum link depth
maxDepth.description: How many link hops away from the start URLs to go. 0 scrapes only the start URLs.

nodes.title: Node runs
nodes.description: How many node runs the hub starts. Each one fetches and parses pages with crawlee-rs. 0 runs the hub alone.

nodeMemoryMbytes.title: Node memory (MB)
nodeMemoryMbytes.description: Memory of each node run. CPU is allocated in proportion to memory, so this is also the node's speed.

nodeConcurrency.title: Node concurrency
nodeConcurrency.description: Upper bound of requests in flight per node; crawlee-rs autoscales below it.

batchSize.title: Batch size
batchSize.description: Requests handed to a node per websocket message.

maxRequests.title: Maximum requests
maxRequests.description: Stop enqueuing after this many requests. 0 means no limit.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Route node requests through Apify Proxy.

apifyProxyGroups.title: Apify Proxy groups
apifyProxyGroups.description: Proxy groups to use, for example RESIDENTIAL. Empty means automatic.

leaseSecs.title: Batch lease (seconds)
leaseSecs.description: A batch a node does not report back within this time is handed to another node.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Set by the hub when it starts node runs. Leave as hub.

hubUrl.title: Hub URL
hubUrl.description: Node mode only: the hub run's container URL.

secret.title: Hub secret
secret.description: Shared secret for the node websocket handshake. Generated by the hub when empty.
